combo.description: For your full combo W then E directly behind your target and instantly R. Follow it up with AA Q AA.
To all in and stick on your target W then R. Flash Q instantly and AA E right after, followed by some more AAs
To surprise the enemy W then E Flash instantly, followed by AA Q as quickly as you can.
When in close range to a target W then instantly AA Q. Continue to AA then E your target back to you.
When able to easily get into melee range W and run up to AA Q then instantly E behind your target, followed by an AA.
To execute a standard gank W then E directly behind your target. Once in range AA and as soon as it connects Q.
